title: Roberto F NDE 5422
content: In 2008, I left my parents house to live by myself. During that time, an old high school friend reappeared. I haven't heard from him since high school times. This friend helped me move, gave me support, advice and kept me company during some hard times. I introduced him to my friends and we would all go out together sometimes. However, he never introduced me to any of his friends. His visits to my house became more and more frequent. He started showing up without telling me in advance, unexpectedly, and sometimes his visits were inconvenient. By the end of January, I decided to have a serious conversation with him. I told him his visits without warning were becoming inconvenient and that it was causing me some problems. He was really hurt and said it wasn´t fair that I was doing that to him. He said that our friendship was over. I felt guilty and thought that maybe I overreacted to his surprise visits, but that time would heal everything. After two weeks without showing up or answering my phone calls, he called me, saying he would stop by my house. I asked why he didn't call me before and he said he wanted some time to cool down and forget about our conversation. He said that now everything was fine between us. The day he went to my house, as usual at an inconvenient time. I was sleeping. He invited me to go fishing with him, and said there were some beautiful water falls in the river we could visit. I didn't want to go because I had slept poorly and was very tired. Something inside of me was telling me not to go; nevertheless, I said, 'yes' and went with him. I remember I had a great time, but my memory ceases from the moment we were going back home in the afternoon. When I woke up, I couldn't open my eyes or move. I felt very cold and pain everywhere. Suddenly, I felt a sensation of peace and tranquility taking over me. Then I saw the image of an unknown man in a beautiful garden. I felt peace like nothing could ever go wrong. I felt safe. This was something inexplicable. As the man started talking to me I had the feeling I knew him somehow, even though I had never met him before. I also noticed a kind of light that came from him and that made me feel calm. It was as if that light was feeding the peace I felt. He told me I could choose either to go with him and see what I have done wrong in my life, or to stay. The moment he questioned me, I immediately thought about my mother. It was as if I had memories of a past life, something I had lived before with vivid details and those memories were related to the very difficult relationship I have with my mother. The man of light looked at me as if he had read my thoughts and told me that I had made my decision. He told me that he would help me find help. Right after that, I felt I was traveling through light. In a blink of an eye, we were above the moon lit treetops, looking at my naked body lying below on the floor. To our right, there were streetlights and houses. He pointed at the houses and directed my attention to a house that had a light on in the porch. We went towards my body. When I was very close to my body, I closed my eyes and the cold and the sharp pain came back. The man of light was still near me, but I could no longer see him, I could only feel his presence and hear his voice. He told me to go towards the streetlights and reminded me of the house with the porch light. I walked through the bushes to the street that seemed far away. I felt weak, but felt his presence giving me strength. As I arrived in the street I saw many houses near me, but I had to go to the one that had the porch light on. When I got near the house, I saw it was empty. I entered through a window that was open. I went to the phone and called the police, my family, and the emergency service. They all said they could only help if they had the address of where I was at, but I didn't know where I was. I looked for a blanket to keep me warm and closed my eyes. I then saw the same man that had guided me there and gave me the option to remain alive, and had been with me in that peaceful place I was before. He told me to wait there because good people would come along to save me. He told me that I should move on with my life. I agreed nodding my head and fell asleep. I woke up with the noise of the house owners arriving. They called for help and in the meanwhile cleaned my wounds and took care of me.

arrival.other_being_detail: An unknown man in a beautiful garden who emitted a calming light and guided the experiencer.

environment.environment_other_detail: Beautiful garden; later, moonlit treetops above the street with houses and streetlights.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: He told the experiencer to wait for help and that they should "move on with my life."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Past-life-like memories related to his mother arose when given a choice.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Peaceful encounter with a man of light preceded the out-of-body viewing of the body; no tunnel described, but traveling through light occurred.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: After returning close to the body, the experiencer (apparently physically) walked to a specific house with a porch light, entered through an open window, and called police/family/emergency services but could not provide the address.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “He told me I could choose either to go with him and see what I have done wrong in my life, or to stay.”; “It was as if I had memories of a past life…”; “Right after that, I felt I was traveling through light.”
